decision: Plan drafted from operator directive 2026-06-09 after C0 (2026-06-09-001) round-6 pause. Provenance: six paid sufficiency rounds on C0 (finding counts 3->2->4->3->4->5), each clearing 100% of the prior round's findings and surfacing a fresh matrix layer — the gate is an unbounded contract enumerator with no stopping condition, the analog of the problem the implementation volley loop solved with Design B strictly-shrinking-count convergence breakers (plan 2026-05-30-002). Scope is the operator's 4-point spec verbatim: round tracking + finding classes, convergence policy (full-clearance + medium/low pin-class -> operator disposition; new high -> block; new plan_contract -> block unless waived), disposition artifact (4 kinds), dogfood against the six C0 rounds as offline fixtures. C0 itself stays draft and is NOT unlocked by this plan; returning to C0 under the new policy is the follow-up step.
rationale: Convergence rule first, then C0 — operator-sequenced. The C0 history doubles as the fixture corpus, making the dogfood feature cheap and honest.

decision: SELF-DEADLOCK GUARD (per the no-self-deadlocking-plans precedent affirmed at plan 2026-04-30-001): this plan modifies the very pre-impl sufficiency gate that would lock it, so it must not be held hostage by the defect it fixes. Budget: at most ONE paid lock attempt. High-severity or genuinely conceptual findings from that attempt are addressed normally; but if the attempt exhibits the non-convergence pattern this plan exists to fix (full clearance of prior findings + a fresh layer of medium/low pin-class findings), the operator may lock with --ignore-sufficiency-findings citing this D-entry as the recorded reason. No automatic override — the operator makes the call either way.
rationale: A convergence-fix plan spiraling in the unconverged gate would be self-parody; the bounded budget plus recorded-override path keeps the fix landable while preserving the gate's authority over real gaps.

decision: Operator approved spending the single D002 paid lock attempt (2026-06-09) and pinned two implementation invariants to preserve: (1) CONSERVATIVE FALLBACK — missing or invalid classifier data MUST become plan_contract (blocking-eligible), never an eligible-for-disposition class; (2) STRICT INVALIDATION — the disposition invalidation rule must be strict enough that a materially changed finding cannot hide behind an old waiver (when in doubt, re-surface as blocking). If the lock attempt itself starts the non-convergent pattern, use the D002 recorded-override path rather than letting the meta-gate eat more budget. After landing: return to C0 and apply the recorded split.
rationale: Both invariants are fail-closed defaults: classification uncertainty and waiver staleness should always err toward blocking, since the policy's whole purpose is to bound spend without weakening the gate's authority over real gaps.
